newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish purchasing managers outlook more optimistic.
newsitem.headline: Danish purchasing managers outlook more optimistic.

text.p: Danish purchasing managers polled in a new survey were more optimistic about Denmark's domestic trade outlook than in an August study, the Danish Organisation of Managers and Executives said on Monday.
Timber and furniture buyers swung to a positive outlook from a negative view in previous polls during the past year, the report's author, Finn Poulsen, told Reuters.

The iron and steel, electronics, chemicals, building, textiles, clothing and paper and graphic industries increased their previous levels of confidence, Poulsen wrote in the organisation's November survey.
All in all 11 out of 13 industries expressed greater optimism about domestic prospects with retailers slightly reducing their home trade expectations.

Export executives saw less change, with managers in eight out of 12 industries -- among them metals, food and beverages, tobacco and wholesale -- expecting more solid growth than they had foreseen in the last survey.
Gloomiest of all were machinery manufacturers who were more pessimistic regarding both home and export business, the survey reported.
